content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ITI Raipur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.raipur.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 20-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ITI Raipur Guest Lecturer posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the ITI Raipur Guest Lecturer recruitment is 20 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for Guest Lecturer posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced for the Guest Lecturer positions at Industrial Training Institute Saddu Raipur.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum age requirement for the Guest Lecturer posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for all Guest Lecturer posts is 18 years. There is no upper age limit specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary structure for the Guest Lecturer positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 140 per hour, with a maximum monthly earning of Rs. 15000.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Stenographer Secretarial Assistant posts?
faq.answer: For Stenographer Secretarial Assistant (Hindi/English), candidates need to have passed 10+2, a shorthand certificate with 100 wpm, and a one-year diploma in Data Entry Operator/Programming.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are needed for the Instrument Mechanic post?
faq.answer: For the Instrument Mechanic position, candidates must have passed High School, possess an NTC/NAC/STC in the relevant trade, and hold a Degree/Diploma in Instrumentation Engineering.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for ITI Raipur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the Guest Lecturer positions?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the official address before the last date.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates will be based on merit, determined by their marks obtained in the technical qualification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Raipur, www.raipur.gov.in. Direct links are provided in the 'Important Links' section of this article.
